retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast nocturnal urban scene featuring heavy motion blur and glowing city lights with ghostly, translucent figures walking through a street.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-contrast night scene characterized by extreme motion blur and light trails. The composition features a central figure in relatively sharper focus compared to surrounding 'ghost' figures who appear as translucent yellow and white streaks. The background is a wash of warm yellow and orange city lights against deep blue and black shadows, creating a sense of kinetic energy and urban isolation.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp foreground subject vs. blurred background figures
Warm yellow light trails vs. cool blue shadows
Vertical human forms vs. horizontal light streaks
Text placement in upper corners balancing the composition
coreInvariants: Heavy motion blur on secondary figures
Deep black shadows in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is positioned slightly left of center, full-body scale, walking toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary subject's dark silhouette against the bright, blurred background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the primary subject, follows the light trails to the right, then moves up to the contrasting typography in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the bottom right and top left corners provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and black shadows providing the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant yellow and orange light trails creating the motion effect.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for specific typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the highlights (yellows/reds) against low-value, high-contrast darks.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast serif with thin hairlines
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected brush script
Script text features a slight upward slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' and 'v' in serif are tightly spaced
Script 'n' and 'w' have elongated, expressive tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for formal structure paired with an expressive script for kinetic energy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif anatomy of the primary text.
Captures the fluid, handwritten energy of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a long-exposure urban night scene with a man in a black shirt walking toward the camera. Surround him with ghostly, motion-blurred figures in yellow and white. Use a background of glowing city lights and neon signs with heavy bokeh. Ensure the bottom third is mostly dark shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase serif text in white to the top left corner. Add a red, hand-drawn script title to the top right corner with a slight upward tilt.

verificationChecks: Is the motion blur significant enough to create 'ghost' figures?
Is the color contrast between the red script and yellow background maintained?
Is the primary subject the only element with recognizable facial features?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names
Do not replicate exact logo shapes
Ensure the background city elements are generic and not identifiable landmarks

mustAchieve: High dynamic range between shadows and highlights

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red script is legible against the bright background.
Ensure the motion blur feels directional and consistent.
Verify that the serif text is crisp and high-contrast.
Confirm the composition feels balanced between the two text blocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal Urban Motion + High Contrast Serif + Expressive Red Script
